summary: Five final-source installer rollback, crash-recovery, authority-drift and exact-artifact recovery cases pass without mutating the production installation.
facts: The focused final-source run completes five tests in 52.089 seconds and exits zero.
Failed installed smoke restores registry and launchers, launcher-publish process death recovers coherently, and rollback-journal process death replays the same transaction.
Recomputed native authority drift is rejected and a partial legacy cache is recoverable only from the exact artifact.
All cases use temporary roots; the live installed generation was not rolled back or otherwise mutated by these tests.
